entry.title: 'The health system in Nepal is not prepared for this'
entry.summary: That's the grim assessment from the ground in the wake of the catastrophic flooding, which damaged or destroyed 7 health facilities, interrupted routine care and is affecting mental health.

entry.title: Whatever happened to the U.S. campaign to ban child marriage?
entry.summary: The global effort to end child marriage is in the news. In the U.S., there's a new bill before Congress (but it's controversial). And the U.N. is designating a day dedicated to ending the practice.

entry.title: With jury deadlocked, judge declares a mistrial in Lindsay Clancy's murder case
entry.summary: The judge in Lindsay Clancy's murder case has declared a mistrial after the jury was unable to agree on a verdict.

entry.title: Scientists map key protein interactions linked with profound autism
entry.summary: Research published in the journal Science illuminates a "missing piece" in the biological understanding of profound autism and offers new targets for drug development.

entry.title: Federal civil rights data about students is finally out. It's different under Trump
entry.summary: The Education Department gathers a massive tranche of civil rights data about public school students. It's now available but harder to parse than in the past.

entry.title: Dry eyes are common in women. Here's why you shouldn't ignore them
entry.summary: Research suggests that around half of all women in the menopausal transition years experience symptoms, like red, watery or gritty-feeling eyes. Hormonal shifts play a role, as do many other factors.

entry.title: Kissing apes, anti-splash urinals: This year's Ig Nobels showcase surprising science
entry.summary: The Ig Nobel Prizes were awarded this week for humorous yet thought-provoking research. This year, the ceremony came with a twist.

entry.title: Medical groups offer vaccine guidance to fill federal vacuum
entry.summary: In the unprecedented absence of federal guidance, leading medical groups are issuing their own recommendations for who should get the COVID-19, flu and RSV immunizations.

entry.title: Whatever happened to ... children infected with HIV due to failures in healthcare?
entry.summary: For years, Pakistan has seen cases of children infected with HIV due to unsafe treatment in clinics and hospitals. A current outbreak numbers hundreds of cases. Why does this problem keep occurring?

entry.title: Dry eyes are common among women. Here's why you shouldn't ignore it
entry.summary: Dry eyes are a very common chronic eye condition among women in perimenopause and beyond. Here's why you shouldn't ignore it.
